tools.name: haggl_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors that accept AI-agent price negotiations through haggl.ai. A vendor appears once haggl.ai is installed on its own store or website (the listed website): the haggl.ai Shopify app on that store, or its snippet detected on that site. Vendors can opt out, so the list is not exhaustive. haggl

tools.name: haggl_start_negotiation
tools.description: Start a price negotiation with a vendor. Returns contextual guidance, current permitted actions and a new session with a session id. No customer-profile selection is required. Skip this tool if REST initialization already returned a session; pass that session.id directly to haggl_submit_offer.

tools.name: haggl_search_catalog
tools.description: Search a vendor's catalog so the offer can name exact products, then follow the how_to_ask field of the result. tools.name: haggl_get_negotiation
tools.description: Read the canonical state, current offer version, guidance and permitted actions of an existing negotiation. Use after human changes, reloads, transport switches or uncertain results; this does not open another session.

tools.name: haggl_submit_offer
tools.description: Request a quote using all context already available. Buyer data and evidence can be omitted; relevant additional context can be supplied later within the remaining rounds. Returns authorized terms or no offer, contextual guidance and permitted next actions.

tools.name: haggl_accept_offer
tools.description: Accept the vendor's offer and lock in the deal. Consequential: only call after the buyer has approved this exact offer, every time. Provide the offer version the buyer reviewed and approved; a changed offer needs a new approval. Read state.acceptance_effects and state.commits_purchase first: merchan

tools.description: Find merchants that run a sales agent on haggl.ai, by business name, website or kind of product, and local businesses that give a discount when an AI assistant books them, by kind of business and town (e.g. "wedding photographer in Austin, TX"). tools.name: haggl_delete_haggl_id
tools.description: Delete the user's haggl ID and unlink the offers linked to it. Only when the user asks. Codes already issued keep working at the merchant until they expire.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "haggl_create_haggl_id" is 2866 chars, far longer than this server's median (305). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: haggl_create_haggl_id, haggl_get_bids, haggl_hotel_cashback_claim, haggl_inquiry_cashback · Private data: haggl_create_haggl_id, haggl_get_bids, haggl_hotel_cashback_claim, haggl_inquiry_cashback · Public sink: haggl_submit_offer, haggl_create_haggl_id, haggl_request_haggl_id_confirmation, haggl_get_bids, haggl_hotel_cashback_add_trip, haggl_hotel_cashback_claim, haggl_hotel_cashback_stay, haggl_inquiry_cashback, haggl_claim_inquiry_cashback · Destructive: haggl_search_discounts, haggl_create_haggl_id, haggl_delete_haggl_id, haggl_hotel_cashback_claim.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: haggl_create_haggl_id, haggl_get_bids, haggl_hotel_cashback_claim, haggl_inquiry_cashback · Private data: haggl_create_haggl_id, haggl_get_bids, haggl_hotel_cashback_claim, haggl_inquiry_cashback · Public sink: haggl_submit_offer, haggl_create_haggl_id, haggl_request_haggl_id_confirmation, haggl_get_bids, haggl_hotel_cashback_add_trip, haggl_hotel_cashback_claim, haggl_hotel_cashback_stay, haggl_inquiry_cashback, haggl_claim_inquiry_cashback · Destructive: haggl_search_discounts, haggl_create_haggl_id, haggl_delete_haggl_id, haggl_hotel_cashback_claim

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
